about_the_game:
There was once a handsome man who had five beautiful wives and a very happy family. Suddenly one day, a snake demon came here, forcibly took his 5 wives to the mountain imprisoned, and sealed their memories, the summer Dragon Boat Festival season, snake demon ability weakened, the man embarked on the journey to save his wife

In Sexy Slime Party, this is a barrage shooting type of light meat pigeon game.

The player will play as the head of the snake, in each battle, there will be a friend, the player must touch them, so that they will join the player's team, like the snake, more and more long, and each Slime has its own unique ability, all produced Slime are random, so the player each time to gather the team is different, each time Will have a different experience. In addition, players will be able to unlock certain skills outside of combat, and skills will also give players additional abilities, adding more help to the player's battle. Finally, the player can also unlock talents, which can increase the player and his teammates damage, health, or shields and other abilities, making the player stronger and stronger.

This is no longer a simple game of eating food to grow longer, but a journey full of challenges and warmth. ​

In the game, the biggest challenge players face is to fight against powerful enemies. Each battle is a battle of wisdom and strategy, and after victory, you can gain valuable experience to help the snake grow and unlock new abilities. ​

Game features

In order to successfully rescue the trapped wife, players need to recruit talents. In the game world, many partners of different skills are waiting to be co-opted. Some partners can give snake instant acceleration ability, surprise in the battle; Others can use a shield to protect the snake from enemy attacks. Each partner has a unique backstory, and interacting with and recruiting them will enrich the game experience for players. ​

The game also uses the painting style of waste picture magic, with cool bullet effects, so that players are immersive combat and exploration

As the game progresses, the greedy snake controlled by the player becomes more and more powerful on the way to growth, and gradually uncover the mysterious conspiracy behind the wife's trapped. Each battle, each new partner, brings the player closer to the goal of rescuing his wife. In this fantasy-filled world of greedy snakes, players will experience the blood of battle, the bonds between partners, and the firm belief of unremitting struggle for love. Are you ready for the journey of redemption? ​
